meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Bharat mein dark spots aur dull skin ke liye kai acche aur budget-friendly options available hain.[www.forbes.com](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/best-vitamin-c-serum/#:~:text=A%20fully%20vegan%20formula%2C%20TruSkin's%20Vitamin%20C,affordable%20considering%20the%20effectiveness%20of%20its%20ingredients.) Aapki skin type aur requirement ke hisaab se yeh kuch behtareen choices hain:

Ye Dot & Key 10% Vitamin C + E 5% Niacinamide Serum dark spots ko tezi se fika karta hai aur dull skin ko **instant glow** deta hai.

Ye Deconstruct Vitamin C Serum For Face 10% Vitamin C + 0.5 % Ferulic Acid pigmentation aur tanning ko hatane ke liye **best beginner-friendly option** hai.

Ye Foxtale Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum pure L-Ascorbic Acid ke sath aata hai jo skin ko deep hydration dekar **luminous aur youthful look** deta hai.

Ye Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum With Mandarin stable Ethyl Ascorbic Acid formula ke sath skin ki dullness dur karta hai aur **uneven skin tone** ko theek karta hai.

Ye Garnier Vitamin C + Face Serum ek lightweight formula hai jo **acne marks aur dark spots** ko kam karne mein madad karta hai.

### Kuch Zaroori Tips:

* Agar aapki skin sensitive hai ya aap pehli baar vitamin C use kar rahe hain, toh **10% concentration** se shuru karein (jaise Dot & Key ya Deconstruct).[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/serum/top-10-vitamin-c-serums/#:~:text=WishCare%20Super%20Bright%20C16%20earns%20consistent%20feedback,patch-test%20behind%20your%20ear%20before%20full-face%20application.)
* Serum lagane ke baad din mein **sunscreen** lagana bilkul na bhulein taaki dark spots aur na badhein.[www.dawaadost.com](https://www.dawaadost.com/blog/5-popular-vitamin-c-serums-for-face#:~:text=Regular%20use%20promotes%20even%20skin%20tone%2C%20reduces,skin.%20*%202.%20TruSkin%20Vitamin%20C%20Serum.)
